svg.title: Square wave (−1 on [−π, 0), 1 on [0, π)) and the partial sums SN(x) = (4/π) Σ sin((2k−1)x)/(2k−1): more harmonics give a better approximation; at the jumps the sums pass through 0, the average of the one-sided limits (Lecture 5, slides 13, 18 and 34)
svg.text: at x = 0 every SN equals 0 = ½[f(0⁺) + f(0⁻)]
